record.original_text: The 30X-SDI Gen 2 Live Streaming Broadcast Camera, in gray, from PTZOptics, features simultaneous 1080p 3G-SDI, HDMI, and IP streaming and offers a 30x optical zoom, which is suitable for large conferencing rooms and auditoriums. It also has a composite output that can be used on its own (without any of the other outputs concurrently) to deliver 576i/480i resolution. The camera streams up to 1080p60 resolution. When streaming over all three of the main outputs at the same time, you can select 1080p60 for SDI and HDMI while up to only 1080p30 for IP. Or you can select 1080p60 for IP and 1080p30 for SDI and HDMI.The 30X-SDI Gen 2 can be powered over PoE or an included power supply. It offers RS-232 and RS-485 serial control, an audio line in for HDMI and IP streaming, and 10 presets via the included IR remote control or 255 via serial or IP control.This HuddleCam controller , designed robust to withstand the rigors of daily production, provides zero latency control over RS-232, RS-422, and RS-485 cabling. It does not require a connection to an Ethernet-based network. training.text: The easy, figure-elongating construction of the NYDJ Marilyn Straight Women's Pull-On Jeans pairs well with everything, thanks to a flattering waist and a versatile, straight-leg fit. Founded in 2003, NYDJ set out to design premium stretch jeans with a fabulous fit that makes every woman feel comfortable and confident—like her best self. All NYDJ jeans are made with Lift Tuck Technology, a proprietary slimming panel with a patented crisscross design to flatten in the front and curve-contouring construction to flatter curves in the back. Headquartered in Los Angeles and inspired by California style and the latest denim trends, NYDJ is always working to bring you the most innovative denim technologies as well as the chicest non-denim pants and pair-perfect tops.

heldout.text: Getting your kids excited about their daily tooth brushing routine requires more than just an ordinary kids toothbrush. Give them the fun and functional GUM Crayola Twistables Toothbrush for kids. It’s one of the best toothbrushes to keep kids engaged with bright and colorful handles, as well as a twistable head that can be extended from the toothbrush handle with a twist of the bottom green knob. When not in use, kids can twist the toothbrush back and store upside down in the included toothbrush cap. The cap doubles as a stand to keep the brush from rolling off the bathroom sink. This toothbrush also comes with soft, antibacterial bristles to further inhibit germ growth. The toothpaste sweet spot is highlighted by the colored bristles in the center of the compact head to teach children how much toothpaste they should be using. If you want to equip your little ones with a kids' toothbrush that will get them enthusiastic about their twice-daily tooth brushing routine, the GUM Crayola Twistable Toothbrush is what you need.
